fields.name: Text1
fields.fieldText: Do you remember the name of the practice where you started treatment? (allow them to provide unprompted response)

fields.name: Other_Textbox
fields.fieldText: Other

fields.name: S11_Text
fields.fieldText: Similarly, after reflecting on your experience with Affordable Dentures and Implants, on a scale of 1 to 10, how likely are you to refer a friend, family member or colleague to Affordable Dentures & Implants?

fields.name: Screen11_Text
fields.fieldText: And finally, briefly tell me why you’d give us that score.

fields.name: Text12
fields.fieldText:
Thank you again for participating in this brief survey. We’re sorry we didn’t live up to your expectations and were unable to service during your visit.
We will aim to do so in the future by taking your feedback into consideration. We hope you consider us should you ever have tooth replacement needs in the future and give us a chance to live up to your expectations again.
Thank you and have a great day.

fields.name: Text13
fields.fieldText:
No problem. I understand you are busy. We’re sorry we were unable to service your dental needs at your recent visit.
We are taking our patient’s feedback into consideration to improve our services and hope you consider us should you ever have tooth replacement needs in the future.
Thank you and have a great day.

fields.name: Text2
fields.fieldText: We’re sorry we couldn’t serve you better. In an effort to help improve our patient experience, would it be okay if I asked you a couple of questions about your recent dental visits?

fields.name: Text3
fields.fieldText:
Great, thank you! This will just take a couple of moments. First I want to ask you a little bit about your experience.
What was it about their process that made you decide to start treatment with them? Was it…

fields.name: Something_else
fields.fieldText: Something else:

fields.name: Text3_a
fields.fieldText: We are sorry we did not offer the treatment or service you needed or were looking for. May I ask what treatment you had done at the dental provider you chose to go see?

fields.name: Text3_b
fields.fieldText: We actually provide that service in many of our practices. Did the staff offer you dental implant-supported dentures as a treatment option?

fields.name: Text3_c
fields.fieldText:
We’re sorry that we didn’t provide the services that you needed in the practice you visited. We will aim to do a better job at explaining our services and treatment that we provide over the phone for patients in the future and consider new treatment options as well.
Thank you for your time and feedback – this has been very helpful for us.
Have a great day!

fields.name: Text4
fields.fieldText: That was really helpful feedback. Now I would like to ask you some questions about why you didn’t start treatment with us on the day of your initial visit. I’ll read some potential examples and you can tell me all that apply. Was it that… (Please check all that apply)

fields.name: Reason
fields.fieldText: Reason:

fields.name: Text5
fields.fieldText: Thank you again for all of your input – we are almost finished by the way! Do you mind if I ask what the final cost of your treatment plan was for the procedure you received? I totally appreciate that this might be a sensitive question, and so I am happy to skip this if you do mind.

fields.name: Amount
fields.fieldText: Amount

fields.name: Text6
fields.fieldText: You’ve been really helpful so far – we are half way there. You mentioned that affordability was a piece that played into your decision. Can I ask, if we had been offering a promotional campaign at the time of your visit as we sometimes do, such as a coupon or other type of discount, would that have changed your mind at the time of your visit?

fields.name: Text6_a
fields.fieldText: You mentioned that your provider offering financing was one of the reasons you chose them. Did you know that we also offer financing?

fields.name: Text6_b
fields.fieldText: Okay, do you mind if I ask why you chose to use the financing the dental provider you chose offered and not ours? I’ll read a couple of examples and you can tell me all that apply by saying yes or no. Was it that…

fields.name: Text6_c
fields.fieldText: Do you mind if I ask how you heard about the financing offered by the provider you ended up choose? Was it that… Please check all that apply

fields.name: Screen6_c_text
fields.fieldText: Something else:

fields.name: Text6_d
fields.fieldText: You mentioned that the provider accepting your insurance played a role in starting treatment with them. Do you mind if I ask, what type of insurance do you use today – is it private insurance, Medicaid, Medicare or something else? It’s totally okay if you mind and we can skip this question as I appreciate it may be sensitive.

fields.name: Private_insurance
fields.fieldText: Private insurance (ask if they know):

fields.name: Text7
fields.fieldText: Do you remember what the cost of the treatment would have been at the Affordable Dentures and Implants location you visited?

fields.name: Screen7_Yes
fields.fieldText: Yes:

fields.name: Text7_a
fields.fieldText: Do you think the quality and type of treatment and products you received were the same or different and if different, whose did you perceive to be superior?

fields.name: Text7_b
fields.fieldText: Was the general treatment you received similar in terms of the number of extractions you ended up receiving, number of arches, type of denture you purchased?

fields.name: Text8
fields.fieldText: Thank you again for being so helpful in our mission to better service patients who visit us. I have just a couple of final questions for you. On a scale of 1 to 10, how likely are you to refer a friend, family member or colleague to the provider you received your final treatment from, where 10 is extremely likely and 1 is not likely at all?

fields.name: S8_TheirScore
fields.fieldText: How come you gave them that score?
